question: Does Dynamic Need improve the strong E006 baseline when the harmful E008 Persona redesign is not carried forward?
hypothesis: Adding semantic T1 need and T0→T1 transition directly to E006 will recover more top-decile lift and possibly AP while preserving the stronger original Persona.
primary_change: add dynamic_need_profile and need_transition directly to E006 strong baseline
secondary_changes: branch from E006 rather than E009 to isolate Dynamic Need from E008 regression

target.censoring: Public candidate data has no true sale timestamp; offline result is associative.

population.eligibility: Same E006/E007 temporal population and untouched future test.
exclusions: Profile-calibration rows excluded from predictive fit.

validation.strategy: same temporal train/future-test; outcome-free cluster selection; paired cluster-bootstrap by lead_id
validation.split_description: Identical E006 future test; model family/hyperparameters held fixed.

items.source: T1 inquiry request fields and point-in-time deltas to T0 need
items.evidence: Explicitly excludes weekday and all broker response outcome fields.
Deterministic cross of reviewed T0/T1 need states.
